name: Low Carb Turkey Taco Skillet

conditions_check.scalable_to_14: yes, source 2 servings x7 = 7 lb ground turkey
conditions_check.fit: FIT - published 446 cal / 6g carbs clears both gates

evidence: Nearest catalog turkey taco dishes are all starch- or liquid-based - turkey-taco-rice-skillet (rice base), turkey-taco-casserole, turkey-taco-soup, and green-chile-ground-turkey-skillet (green-chile flavor, not classic taco); this candidate is a no-starch low-carb skillet (ground turkey + bell pepper + Mexican cheese, no rice/bean/pasta), so it differs on the starch axis that defines those plates and is not a duplicate.
borderline_reason: Structurally adjacent to turkey-taco-rice-skillet - same protein, taco/Tex-Mex spice family, skillet method; distinguished only by the absence of the rice base. Flagged so the decider can confirm the low-carb no-starch version is wanted as a distinct plate rather than a rice-skillet twin.
cross_protein_collision: This is structurally a generic low-carb taco-meat skillet (ground protein + taco spice + bell pepper + cheese, no starch). Watch other-protein pools for a low-carb ground-beef taco skillet or low-carb chicken taco skillet - any of those would be the same dinner with the protein swapped. Also note keto-cheeseburger-skillet is already accepted (different flavor family, cheeseburger not taco - not a collision).
unmapped_ok: Carries 'shredded Mexican blend cheese' as unmapped; per v2.1 5.1 this is wanted for the pricer lane, not a penalty.
